title: Minimum Operations To Halve Array Sum
statement:
In one operation, choose a positive array value and replace it with exactly half its current value. Return the fewest operations needed to reduce the array sum by at least half.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [5,19,8,1]
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: nums = [3,8,20]
Output: 3
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= nums[i] <= 10^7`
